column1: # Pinned inputs Dependabot cannot update, and how scripts/update-pins.sh
# (run monthly by .github/workflows/pins-update.yml) keeps each one current.
# docs/RELEASE-ARTIFACTS.md "How pins are kept current" lists every pin and its
# updater; scripts/check_pins_test.go fails when a pin has none.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   name      the pin's name: <name>_VERSION / <name>_SHA256 in the workflows,
#             or COSIGN for internal/release/cosign.lock
#   kind      github   — a GitHub release asset, version + SHA-256 pinned
#             pypi     — a PyPI package pinned by version (`pip install x==v`)
#             cosign   — internal/release/cosign.lock (version + per-arch SHA-256)
#   source    owner/repo (github, cosign) or the PyPI project name
#   asset     the release asset, {v} = version without the leading v
#   checksums the release's checksums file, {v} likewise
#   identity  the keyless signing identity upstream signs the checksums with
#             ("-" = upstream publishes no signature; the checksums file and
#             the asset hash are what is verified)
#   issuer    that identity's OIDC issuer ("-" with no identity)
GITLEAKS
ACTIONLINT
KUBECONFORM
GOLANGCI_LINT
GRYPE
RUFF
SEMGREP
COSIGN
